def get_features(db: dict, entity_ids, seed_time) -> pd.DataFrame:
    seed_time = pd.Timestamp(seed_time)
    if seed_time.tzinfo is not None:
        seed_time = seed_time.tz_localize(None)

    orders = db['orders']
    order_items = db['order_items']
    reviews = db['reviews']
    payments = db['payments']

    # Only orders already placed before seed_time
    orders_before = orders[orders['order_purchase_timestamp'] <= seed_time][
        ['order_id', 'customer_id',
         'order_purchase_timestamp', 'order_approved_at',
         'order_delivered_carrier_date', 'order_delivered_customer_date',
         'order_estimated_delivery_date']
    ]

    items = order_items[['order_id', 'product_id', 'seller_id', 'price',
                         'freight_value', 'ts']].merge(
        orders_before, on='order_id', how='inner'
    )
    items = items[items['ts'] <= seed_time].copy()

    result = pd.DataFrame(index=pd.Index(entity_ids, name='product_id'))

    if items.empty:
        for c in ['total_items', 'total_orders', 'sum_price', 'mean_price',
                  'min_price', 'max_price', 'std_price', 'sum_freight',
                  'mean_freight', 'std_freight', 'unique_customers',
                  'unique_sellers', 'days_since_first', 'days_since_last',
                  'purchase_span_days', 'avg_purchase_interval',
                  'min_purchase_interval', 'max_purchase_interval',
                  'unique_purchase_dates', 'items_last30', 'items_last90',
                  'items_last180', 'items_prev90_ratio', 'orders_last90',
                  'momentum_30_90', 'momentum_90_180',
                  'avg_review_score', 'count_reviews', 'std_review_score',
                  'share_score_ge4', 'share_score_le2',
                  'review_recency_weighted', 'days_since_last_review',
                  'total_payments', 'mean_installments', 'credit_card_ratio',
                  'mean_delivery_days', 'on_time_ratio',
                  'est_delivery_delay_days', 'approved_lag_mean',
                  'n_sellers_price_min', 'price_vs_market',
                  'days_since_last_seller', 'review_item_ratio',
                  'payment_value_mean']:
            result[c] = 0.0
        return result.astype(float)

    grp = items.groupby('product_id')
    idx = entity_ids

    def rei(s):
        return s.reindex(idx).fillna(0).astype(float)

    # 1. Basic counts
    result['total_items'] = rei(grp.size())
    result['total_orders'] = rei(grp['order_id'].nunique())

    # 2. Price features
    result['sum_price'] = rei(grp['price'].sum())
    result['mean_price'] = rei(grp['price'].mean())
    result['min_price'] = rei(grp['price'].min())
    result['max_price'] = rei(grp['price'].max())
    result['std_price'] = rei(grp['price'].std())

    # 3. Freight
    result['sum_freight'] = rei(grp['freight_value'].sum())
    result['mean_freight'] = rei(grp['freight_value'].mean())
    result['std_freight'] = rei(grp['freight_value'].std())

    # 4. Uniques
    result['unique_customers'] = rei(grp['customer_id'].nunique())
    result['unique_sellers'] = rei(grp['seller_id'].nunique())

    # 5. Time features
    first_purchase = grp['ts'].min()
    last_purchase = grp['ts'].max()
    result['days_since_first'] = rei((seed_time - first_purchase).dt.days)
    result['days_since_last'] = rei((seed_time - last_purchase).dt.days)
    span = (last_purchase - first_purchase).dt.days
    result['purchase_span_days'] = rei(span)

    # 6. Intervals
    unique_events = items[['product_id', 'order_id', 'ts']].drop_duplicates(
        subset=['product_id', 'order_id']).sort_values(['product_id', 'ts'])
    unique_events['prev_ts'] = unique_events.groupby('product_id')['ts'].shift()
    unique_events['interval_days'] = (unique_events['ts'] - unique_events['prev_ts']).dt.days
    result['avg_purchase_interval'] = rei(unique_events.groupby('product_id')['interval_days'].mean())
    result['min_purchase_interval'] = rei(unique_events.groupby('product_id')['interval_days'].min())
    result['max_purchase_interval'] = rei(unique_events.groupby('product_id')['interval_days'].max())
    result['unique_purchase_dates'] = rei(unique_events.groupby('product_id')['ts'].nunique())

    # 7. Trend / recency window features (strictly past)
    ts_d = (seed_time - items['ts']).dt.days
    w30 = items['product_id'][(ts_d < 30)].value_counts()
    w90 = items['product_id'][(ts_d < 90)].value_counts()
    w180 = items['product_id'][(ts_d < 180) & (ts_d >= 90)].value_counts()
    p90 = items['product_id'][(ts_d >= 90) & (ts_d < 180)].value_counts()
    result['items_last30'] = rei(w30)
    result['items_last90'] = rei(w90)
    result['items_last180'] = rei(items['product_id'][ts_d < 180].value_counts())
    result['items_prev90_ratio'] = rei(w90) / rei(p90).replace(0, np.nan)
    result['items_prev90_ratio'] = result['items_prev90_ratio'].fillna(0)
    result['orders_last90'] = rei(items['order_id'][ts_d < 90].groupby(items['product_id']).nunique())
    result['momentum_30_90'] = rei(w30) / rei(w90).replace(0, np.nan)
    result['momentum_30_90'] = result['momentum_30_90'].fillna(0)
    result['momentum_90_180'] = rei(w90) / (rei(w90) + rei(w180)).replace(0, np.nan)
    result['momentum_90_180'] = result['momentum_90_180'].fillna(0)

    # 8. Reviews: only reviews already ANSWERED before seed_time
    rev_ok = reviews[reviews['review_answer_timestamp'] <= seed_time][
        ['order_id', 'review_score']]
    rev_merged = items[['order_id', 'product_id']].merge(rev_ok, on='order_id', how='inner')
    if not rev_merged.empty:
        rg = rev_merged.groupby('product_id')['review_score']
        result['avg_review_score'] = rei(rg.mean())
        result['count_reviews'] = rei(rg.count())
        result['std_review_score'] = rei(rg.std())
        result['share_score_ge4'] = rei(rev_merged.assign(x=(rev_merged['review_score'] >= 4).astype(float))
                                        .groupby('product_id')['x'].mean())
        result['share_score_le2'] = rei(rev_merged.assign(x=(rev_merged['review_score'] <= 2).astype(float))
                                        .groupby('product_id')['x'].mean())
        last_rev = rev_merged.groupby('product_id').apply(
            lambda g: (seed_time - rev_ok.set_index('order_id')
                       .reindex(g['order_id']).index).days.max(), include_groups=False)
        result['days_since_last_review'] = rei(last_rev)
        # recency-weighted mean score (reviews within 180 days weigh more)
        rev_w = rev_merged.copy()
        rev_w['age'] = (seed_time - items.set_index('order_id')['ts']
                        .reindex(rev_w['order_id']).values).days
        rev_w['w'] = np.exp(-rev_w['age'] / 180.0)
        rev_w['ws'] = rev_w['review_score'] * rev_w['w']
        result['review_recency_weighted'] = rei(rev_w.groupby('product_id')['ws'].sum() /
                                                rev_w.groupby('product_id')['w'].sum())
    else:
        for c in ['avg_review_score', 'count_reviews', 'std_review_score',
                  'share_score_ge4', 'share_score_le2',
                  'review_recency_weighted']:
            result[c] = 0.0
        result['days_since_last_review'] = 9999.0

    # 9. Payments (payment facts tied to orders placed before seed_time)
    pay_merged = items[['order_id', 'product_id']].merge(
        payments[['order_id', 'payment_installments', 'payment_type', 'payment_value']],
        on='order_id', how='inner')
    if not pay_merged.empty:
        result['total_payments'] = rei(pay_merged.groupby('product_id').size())
        result['mean_installments'] = rei(pay_merged.groupby('product_id')['payment_installments'].mean())
        pay_merged['is_credit'] = (pay_merged['payment_type'] == 'credit_card').astype(float)
        result['credit_card_ratio'] = rei(pay_merged.groupby('product_id')['is_credit'].mean())
        result['payment_value_mean'] = rei(pay_merged.groupby('product_id')['payment_value'].mean())
    else:
        result['total_payments'] = 0.0
        result['mean_installments'] = 0.0
        result['credit_card_ratio'] = 0.0
        result['payment_value_mean'] = 0.0

    # 10. Delivery / logistics: only facts already realized before seed_time
    deliv = items[items['order_delivered_customer_date'].notna() &
                  (items['order_delivered_customer_date'] <= seed_time)].copy()
    if not deliv.empty:
        deliv['delivery_days'] = (deliv['order_delivered_customer_date'] - deliv['ts']).dt.days
        deliv['delay'] = (deliv['order_delivered_customer_date'] -
                          deliv['order_estimated_delivery_date']).dt.days
        dg = deliv.groupby('product_id')
        result['mean_delivery_days'] = rei(dg['delivery_days'].mean())
        result['on_time_ratio'] = rei(deliv.assign(x=(deliv['delay'] <= 0).astype(float))
                                      .groupby('product_id')['x'].mean())
        result['est_delivery_delay_days'] = rei(dg['delay'].mean())
    else:
        result['mean_delivery_days'] = 0.0
        result['on_time_ratio'] = 0.0
        result['est_delivery_delay_days'] = 0.0

    # approval lag (known once order is placed; approved usually same days)
    appr = items[items['order_approved_at'].notna()].copy()
    if not appr.empty:
        appr['lag'] = (appr['order_approved_at'] - appr['order_purchase_timestamp']).dt.total_seconds() / 86400.0
        result['approved_lag_mean'] = rei(appr.groupby('product_id')['lag'].mean())
    else:
        result['approved_lag_mean'] = 0.0

    # 11. Market-level features: price vs global market (past only)
    glob_mean_price = items['price'].mean()
    result['n_sellers_price_min'] = result['min_price']
    result['price_vs_market'] = result['mean_price'] / glob_mean_price if glob_mean_price else 0.0

    # 12. Seller recency
    last_seller = items.groupby('product_id')['ts'].max()
    result['days_since_last_seller'] = rei((seed_time - last_seller).dt.days)

    # 13. Review-to-item ratio
    result['review_item_ratio'] = result['count_reviews'] / result['total_items'].replace(0, np.nan)
    result['review_item_ratio'] = result['review_item_ratio'].fillna(0)

    result = result.reindex(idx).fillna(0).astype(float)
    return result
